exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix diagnostic-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

exec card create 'Lifecycle task'
exec card create 'Claimed task'
exec card create 'Dependency'
exec card create --depends-on diagnostic-3 'Blocked task'
exec card create --type checkpoint 'Approval gate'
exec card create 'Cycle prerequisite'
exec card create --depends-on diagnostic-6 'Cycle dependent'

exec card close diagnostic-1
! exec card close diagnostic-1
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/close-closed.txt
! exec card reopen diagnostic-2
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/reopen-open.txt

exec card --actor owner claim diagnostic-2
! exec card --actor worker claim diagnostic-2
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/claim-claimed.txt
! exec card --actor worker claim diagnostic-4
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/claim-blocked.txt
! exec card --actor worker claim diagnostic-5
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/claim-checkpoint.txt

! exec card checkpoint approve diagnostic-2
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/resolve-task.txt

! exec card edit diagnostic-2 --depends-on diagnostic-2
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/self-dependency.txt
! exec card edit diagnostic-6 --depends-on diagnostic-7
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/dependency-cycle.txt
! exec card edit diagnostic-2 --depends-on -diagnostic-3
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/missing-dependency.txt

-- golden/close-closed.txt --
error: diagnostic-1: close requires lifecycle open or cancelled; issue lifecycle is closed
-- golden/reopen-open.txt --
error: diagnostic-2: reopen requires lifecycle closed or cancelled; issue lifecycle is open
-- golden/claim-claimed.txt --
error: claim requires an unclaimed issue; active claim belongs to "owner"
-- golden/claim-blocked.txt --
error: claim requires all dependencies to be closed
-- golden/claim-checkpoint.txt --
error: claim requires an executable issue; issue type is checkpoint
-- golden/resolve-task.txt --
error: checkpoint resolution requires type checkpoint; issue type is task
-- golden/self-dependency.txt --
error: an issue cannot be its own dependency
-- golden/dependency-cycle.txt --
error: dependency graph must remain acyclic
-- golden/missing-dependency.txt --
error: issue does not depend on "diagnostic-3"
